show.description: Yash Narain, a failed husband and broken man, gets a second chance at life when he wakes up ten years in the past. With his mother Alka alive, his ex-wife Shree slipping away, and his treacherous friend Kumar plotting against him, Yash risks everything in the volatile world of Bitcoin to rise as India’s ‘Crypto King.’ But every fortune comes at a deadly cost. Watch Now!
